title: I need more than 3 alarms
body:
If you need more than 3 unique alarm schedules, you can add more with a little trick.

Once you’ve added 3 and the ‘add’ button disappears, press and hold anywhere on the screen for 2 seconds.

You should feel a haptic and the ‘add’ button will re-appear. You can now add up to 7 alarms.
